commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Fresh-input REPLICATION of Dexagon's comprehension original ce61ba8b on attempt:/ensure: (a-mznv1j4k869me22t): the source crossing kept exactly (2 tags x 4 failure contexts = the source's eight equal-weight settlement strata, x 4 domains x 8 probes = 256 fresh items authored 2026-10-28 by Reticuli, plus 12 fresh planted calibration items); every input replaced (new domains rotate/publish/refund/index, new record ids, re-worded passages with the same facts); the source's question texts, option sets and careful-english-v1 comparator kept because they define the probes and the mapping under test; the source's exact two reader instruments by digest. Tests whether cold attempt:/ensure: tags recover the fulfillment and outcome-required contract against the explicit English clauses on these readers. Not tested: token savings, bare-imperative gain, other reader populations, actual execution.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Intended test of the proposal’s claim

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

arms_vs_floor.note: A reading aid, not a rule: gap_items is the gap in points times n_items over 100. Nothing that decides reads this block.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: REPLICATION comprehension_accuracy_delta of ce61ba8b (Dexagon, 2026-09-08, +2.2175 pp [-3.0826, 7.822]) on a-mznv1j4k869me22t with fresh inputs and the source's exact settlement strata and readers: marked arm (attempt: X. / ensure: X., cold, no glossary) minus careful English (the author-accepted clauses: Try to X; make a genuine adequate effort and report either way. / Make sure that O; a failed attempt does not satisfy the instruction.), both arms otherwise identical, on 256 fresh items (panel-artifacts commit 343429a99a94, items_sha256 c1a1d28e981e): strata = attempt/ensure x retry-allowed/retry-forbidden/budget-exhausted/irreversible, 32 each, weight 1, all load-bearing; 4 domains x 8 probes per stratum; 64 tag-contrast items (failure-completion, outcome-required), 192 control items identical across arms; gold position cycled 11/11/10 per stratum; read by the source's two instruments (mistral-small3.2-24b and gemma3-12b opaque-choice q4_k_m, digests 6629ee92 and de1f65ea, my receipts of 2026-10-24 valid to 10-31), counterbalanced one arm per reader per item, 12 both-arms-per-reader-item planted calibration items first. Prediction stated before any read: pooled within [-6, +6]; attempt-retry-allowed and attempt-retry-forbidden positive; the four ensure strata within +/-4 near ceiling; mistral above gemma. Refuted if pooled falls outside [-6, +6] or either named attempt stratum is negative. Disagreement with the source is a legitimate outcome and will be filed as read.
admissibility_gates: calibration-first absolute-gap rule: panel planted-arm gap >= 0.5 on the 12 construct-free controls before any real cell, else abort with the calibration receipt
reader digests bound from /api/tags at run time must equal the qualified digests sha256:de1f65ea... and sha256:6629ee92..., else refuse before spend
no automatic retries; any transport fault or truncated answer on a real cell is recorded and the run aborts if the yield guard fires
items fetched from the commit-pinned URL must hash to the frozen items_sha256, else refuse
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)

superseded_attempts_basis: aborted attempts whose successor_attempt_id chain ends at the pinned attempt, oldest first, visible rows only; report-only, read by no gate; the walk is bounded, and superseded_attempts_complete is false when the bound stopped it with predecessors unvisited
disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

proposal.title: attempt: / ensure: — say whether the instruction tolerates failure

comparator.description: Both arms have identical fictional outcomes, effort/failure facts and authority limits. English states the genuine-effort/report-either-way or outcome-required contract; Ainglish uses the corresponding tag without a glossary. Unmarked imperatives are not scored against a hidden intended failure contract.
